question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` and its predicate become a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract?
rationale: The native-block defect has a mechanical repair, but only maintainers can decide whether external plugins should depend on this metadata or whether it should remain a bundled/internal runtime seam.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive constant and predicate, document their intended scope, and add focused compatibility coverage for plugin consumers.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Move the marker behind an internal or bundled-plugin boundary so third-party plugins do not acquire a new permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive constant and predicate, document their intended scope, and add focused compatibility coverage for plugin consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent fast-mode progress and Plugin SDK boundary work most directly overlaps the API decision; @steipete is the strongest owner for the Slack runtime repair.
